name: Rigorous System & API Workflow
description: Executes real shell commands to prepare a directory, fetches real JSON data from a REST API, parses it using Python, and uses plugins to log and mock-email the result before cleaning up.

config.command:
cat << 'EOF' > {{variables.temp_dir}}/process.py
import json
import sys

try:
    data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    print(f"{data['name']} works at {data['company']['name']}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error parsing data: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)
EOF
python3 {{variables.temp_dir}}/process.py '{{fetch_user_data.output}}'

config.subject: User Processed
config.body: The result from the API and Python parsing is: {{process_data.output}}
